$comment: Shared types every intent schema can reference with { "type": "ref", "ref": "<name>" }. Format: docs/intents.md §2.

icon.doc: A Font Awesome name ('car', 'fas fa-car', ['fab', 'discord']), a lucide name, or an image URL ('nui://…', 'https://…', anything with .png/.webp).

color.doc: Any CSS colour. Prefer a theme token (var(--success)); fixed colours are for things the theme can't know.

status.doc: Semantic tone, drawn with the theme's status tokens.

anchor.doc: Where on the screen, --nk-edge from the edge. 'top'/'bottom'/'left'/'right' and ox's 'right-center' are accepted aliases.

metadata.doc: Detail rows shown beside an item: strings, { label, value, progress } rows, or a { key: value } map.

difficulty.doc: A preset, or a custom zone: areaSize in degrees and speedMultiplier (1 = one turn in 2 s).
